title: Travel: John Lennon – Palma de Mallorca to London | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono flew from Palma de Mallorca in Spain to London, England, on 21 April 1971.

This was the end of the first of several trips to Mallorca over the coming weeks, in an attempt to gain custody of Ono’s daughter Kyoko, whom they had last seen in August 1970. Lennon and Ono had received a lead that the seven-year-old was living on Mallorca with her father Tony Cox and his wife Melinda, and managed to locate the girl on 20 April.

This was a very brief stay in England. After spending just one night at Tittenhurst Park, they flew again to Mallorca the following day.
